I authorize G0 first provider contact for Cycle-005 under the acquisition apparatus at companion digest `sha256:073c7ff2d5acb6db548bddd34e34de4e65eaeaaff31a6051cdc05ccfddb8e4c6`, containing 23 assets, referencing Gate-A acceptance record `sha256:f63c90346befb96c4237d571972c6304e4f924a5ccbe231b1029b61a8dfba16c` and the acquisition manifest companion `lab/evidence/cycle-005/acquisition-manifest.sha256` at that same digest. An apparatus identity other than the one named here carries no authority under this record, and neither does a Gate-A record other than the one named here.

I authorize no retries and no alternate routes beyond the behavior the apparatus itself defines: the apparatus carries no retry path, so a timeout or transport error is terminal for that candidate, and redirects remain refused off-allowlist and capped at three hops with each hop re-validated for `https:` and exact-host membership. No candidate may be substituted, added, removed or reordered.

Pinned contact references, fixed here and before contact, dependent on nothing observed. Rank 1 USGS `sites` = `01646500` (Potomac River near Washington, DC, Little Falls Pump Station). Rank 2 NOAA CO-OPS `station` = `9414290` (San Francisco, CA). Preserved Gate-A scientific decisions. Every scientific decision I made at Gate A carries forward intact and unaltered. The class-(ii) documented-span method for `history_years` stands for all candidates: history_years = (end_ms - start_ms) / YEAR_MS with YEAR_MS = 365.25 x 86,400,000, conservative for the >= 3-year gate.
